_comment: Film 75 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5, 0.10 USD per track, 6 tracks, 2026-11-25). Method as Film 69: one track per chapter; chapters = sections of timing.json (H | 1 | 2,M | 3 | 4 | 5,A2 + end screen). Mystic and dark, not uplifting (brief): drones, pads, sparse piano, cello, glass and distant wordless choir; no celesta. Files in /tmp/claude-0/f75/audio/music, not in the repo (URLs in music/urls.txt). Prompt sent = style + ' A <len> track. ' + mood.
style: Instrumental underscore for a calm, thoughtful editorial documentary about why human minds are not ready for superintelligence. Mystical and dark, not uplifting: an ancient stone-age hand holding a glowing sphere in the night, two clocks running at different speeds, a quiet room lit by a phone screen. Deep warm drones, slow dark pads, sparse felt piano notes far apart, a low bowed cello line, glass-harmonica and bowed-glass textures, a very distant soft wordless choir pad, a little tape warmth. No celesta, no music box, no bells melody, no drums, no percussion, no beat, no vocals with words, no melody hook, not pop, not epic, not triumphant, not hopeful, not kitschy, not cinematic trailer. Very quiet, narrow dynamic range, slow, made to sit under a speaking voice.

M0.chapter: H (godlike AI and Stone Age brains, the headline, the pulse, the reflex older than our species, the gap, three clocks)
M0.mood: uneasy and close: a low pulsing drone like a slow heartbeat felt rather than heard, a single dark cello note that swells and fades, sparse low piano notes, a faint glassy shimmer; something ancient waking in a modern room; steady and calm throughout, no build-up

M1.chapter: 1 (the three old reflexes: fear before thought, grab it before they do, tomorrow like today; Bengio C2, the doubling, Wilson K1, institutions)
M1.mood: primal and watchful: a deep cave-like drone, slow breathing choir pad far away, a low cello figure of two notes repeating patiently, rare felt piano notes, bowed glass; old instincts moving under the surface; calm and restrained, a slight darkening in the middle, no swell

M2.chapter: 2, M (how fast rules move: the EU AI law, seven years, the ozone hole and the treaty with an update built in; subscribe call)
M2.mood: slow and grave like stone and paper: a long sustained low string pad, soft glass harmonica tones high above, very sparse piano; a cold wide sky over a slow institution; patient and contemplative, a faint warmth at the end without becoming hopeful

M3.chapter: 3 (the fast clock: noticing, Harari C1, consciousness, the sentence test, competition, meditation, one breath, the money, the first test)
M3.mood: inward and mysterious: a soft breathing pad that rises and falls like slow breath, a gentle felt piano figure of a few notes with long silences, a low cello sustain, distant glass shimmer, the far choir returns softly; looking inside your own mind in the dark; restrained, intimate, no uplift

M4.chapter: 4 (set both clocks: an evening a few years on, the grade, testing before release, the UN framework, 135 leaders; not settled; the race is a product of choices)
M4.mood: suspended and thoughtful: a low warm drone with a slow pulse like a distant clock without any percussion, cello and pad in long tones, sparse piano, bowed glass; a possible future seen through fog; calm, open, unresolved, not hopeful

M5.chapter: 5, A2 + end screen (the headline again, you notice it, one breath, two clocks, the gap small enough to steer; upgrade our minds and our rules; closing call)
M5.mood: still and grave: the heartbeat-like drone of the opening returns, slower, with the low cello and a few distant piano notes, a wide still choir pad; quiet resolve without triumph; ends on one long decaying dark open chord fading into silence
